articleTitle: Modern Training of Business Information Systems in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The use of Business Information Systems is widespread in various sectors of the economy. Their application in the field of trade and retail industry is particularly strong. With the advent of the Internet and the development of Internet services, it became necessary to adopt a new approach to the optimization and management of processes in the field of trade. This was dictated by the advent of electronic and internet commerce. All this requires improving the qualifications and skills of personnel in the field of commerce, especially as regards e-commerce. This report examines the possibilities of conducting Business Information Systems training for entrepreneurs, traders and the training of personnel in the field of e-commerce. Several Business Information Systems have been reviewed and analyzed for the needs of e-commerce training. Some basic methodological guidelines for conducting Business Information Systems training for personnel in the field of e-commerce are presented.

articleTitle: Changes of copper losses during the service of distribution transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper is part of a series of articles concerning the changes of losses in transformers as result of extended exploitation. The paper discusses and analyses the obtained loss values of 199 pcs. network transformers after a long service life. The aftermath obtained evidently represent an raise in the measured costs an electrical energy the tabulated values. The factors that affect the increased losses are illustrated for the two main types of transformer coil, according to the shape of the conductor, which are respectively introduces in operation in the period up to 1999 and beyond until 2022. The augmentation of losses over a period of 5 years r% are calculated according to the least squares model. Through the statistical values collected over the years, a method for determining the losses in copper is presented and approximating mathematical function is given. The presented analysis demonstrates a good precision of the model.

articleTitle: The Output Prediction of a Boost DC-DC Converter Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: A boost DC to DC converter is a converter with an output voltage greater than the input voltage. A boost converter is also known as a step-up converter since it “steps up” the input voltage. The paper shows the connection between boost DC-DC transistor converters and machine learning approaches. From machine learning approaches we used classification i.e., decision trees techniques. In the paper we define the boost converter and gave its equation. Then the database was described and the way we used WEKA for output prediction. At the end we discussed the obtained results.

articleTitle: Adapting the Teaching of Academic Writing to the Emergence of Natural Language Generators
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Natural Language Generators are already consistently impossible for humans to distinguish from human writing. They have been used to develop personalized tests, but also to plagiarize essays. This paper asks what are the issues and opportunities brought about by such algorithms and seeks to map potential directions for an education that is successful in overcoming plagiarism issues, while still teaching the principles of proper academic writing, but also in teaching students how to deploy NLG algorithms to their own use.

articleTitle: Model-Based Design of a Buck ZVS Quasi-Resonant DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Power electronic devices and electrical energy conversion systems are widely used in the realization of the concept of green and circular economy. In view of the ever-increasing share of the energy that is converted, the questions related to the energy indicators of electronic converters are extremely important. One of the concepts for increasing the efficiency of power circuits is the use of soft switching based on the use of resonant switches. These circuits are known as quasi-resonant. The work examines the principle of operation, the main ratios describing electromagnetic processes and a mathematical model of a quasi-resonant Zero Voltage Switching Buck DC - DC converter. Then, on the basis of numerical experiments conducted with the model, the optimal values of the resonant elements were determined with a view to minimal voltage loading of the semiconductor switches. The proposed design approach is suitable for use in power circuits for which no suitable design methodologies have been established.

articleTitle: Electric Load Forecasting in Energy Power Systems Based on Online Gaussian Process Regression Coupled with Multilayer Perceptron Kernel Method
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Electricity generation must follow the consumption profile to ensure the optimal management and stability of power systems. In order to maximize profits and efficiently utilize their power system infrastructure while reducing the risk of losses, power electric companies need to make their systems work in a configuration that matches supply with customer demand. This requires the development of a predictive robust model that can accurately forecast future electricity consumption. In this study, an approach based on Gaussian process learning with updating of observed values is proposed to perform short-term predictions of electric load. Comparative studies have been performed with standard models based on linear (Lin), square exponential (SE), radial basis function (RBF), rational quadratic (RQ), multilayer perceptron (MLP), periodic (Per) and Materne (Mv) kernels. The observations are injected into the dataset to train the model before each prediction. Each model was tested on the CEB load data. The results show that the proposed model based on the MLP kernel outperforms standard Gaussian process models based on statistical criteria.

articleTitle: Basic requirements for digitization of e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper outlines the key requirements for digitalization of e-commerce. The main stages of technical construction of e-commerce are defined. The indicators of successful e-commerce digitization are presented and dependencies are established on the basis of which they can be determined. A methodology for selecting an e-commerce business information system from existing solutions is developed. An example of an implemented e-commerce solution based on this methodology is given.

articleTitle: Simulation of Transformers' Characteristics in Laboratory Exercises for Electrical Engineers
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper presents the creation of models of different laboratory works aiming the simulation of transformers' characteristics. The real experimental benches are represented by mathematical models in Matlab-Simulink environment. The created models are used for simulation of different main characteristics with high importance for the education of electrical specialists and engineers.

articleTitle: Influence of the Asymmetrical Load on Losses in Low Voltage Network
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this article, we present contemporary models for determining active power losses in low-voltage electrical networks. We demonstrate their application to asymmetrical load evaluations. We give a short illustrative example of the effect of balancing the phase loads in a low-voltage electrical network.

articleTitle: Simulation of a single-phase induction motor for educational purposes
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper presents the development of a mathematical model of a single-phase induction motor for laboratory works. The experimental test bench that is used in the real exercises is represented by a mathematical model, created in the Matlab/Simulink environment. The created model is used for simulation of different main characteristics with high importance for the education of electrical specialists and engineers and studies the behavior of the single-phase motor with different kinds of run-capacitors, which is not possible in the real experimental bench at the Technical University of Sofia.

articleTitle: Modeling, Design and Prototyping of a Synchronous DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In order to gain usage of solar power the produced energy from solar panels has to go through a DC-DC converter. The DC-DC converter regulates and monitors the output voltage provided to the battery. The converter uses a pair of super-fast switching MOS transistors to regulate the output voltage and an inductance and a capacitor to store that energy during the off half cycle. To control the fast switching of the transistors an integrated circuit is used. The LM5146 used in this project can turn off and on the transistors up to 1 billion times per second, can monitor the output current and shut itself down if the supplied voltage in below a certain point. In the following papers it's presented the designing of such DC-DC converter. The verification of the designing has been made with computer simulations and solved equations.

articleTitle: Design of a New Version of a System for Intelligent Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This article proposes a new model of agricultural automation system, including a meteorological station. Precision agriculture, also called automated agriculture according to the specifics of the site, is a new technology that allows producers to adequately manage arable land depending on spatially differentiated information. It is an innovative, technologically and information-based, intelligent approach to reducing costs in agriculture, increasing yields and crop quality, as well as effective control of plant diseases.

articleTitle: Idle Running Losses in Medium Voltage Overhead Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This article examines the issue of Idle Running Losses in Medium Voltage Overhead Power Lines. Experimental measurements are performed. Based on the results of the measurements, a convenient empirical model is proposed for the calculation of transversal (conductance) losses during the operation of the distribution overhead power lines. Numerical examples are presented, and important implications are discussed.

articleTitle: Matlab Implementation of Induction Motor Exercises for Characteristics Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper presents the implementation in Matlab Simulink of different laboratory exercises with induction motors, aiming at their digitalization. The created models follow the students' operations in the real exercises to determine the main characteristics of induction motors, which are a basic knowledge for specialists in the field of electrical engineering for their application in different industrial sectors.

articleTitle: Analysis of Requirement and Cost of Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserve of the Kosovo Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article presents analyses of the requirement and cost of the Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserve (aFRR) in the Kosovo Electric Power System. It is based on estimations of the maximum system load as one of the main factors to calculate the required amount of aFRR, as well as on the price of aFRR capacity in the balancing market to obtain the aFRR procurement cost. The model is constructed using deterministic methodology defined in the ENTSO-E (European Network of Transmission System Operators) manual and maximum system load in different time frames. The aim is to conclude concerning the impact of the duration of the single time interval on which base the calculations for satisfaction of the aFRR requirement are performed on the amount and cost of aFRR. This impact is illustrated with some numerical examples.

articleTitle: Increasing the Investment Attractiveness of SMEs by Applying the Drop-Shipping Supply Chain Model in Context of Environmental, Social and Corporate Governance
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The main objective of this research is to empirically verify the impact of environmental, social and corporate governance (ESG) on the drop-shipping model. The survey was conducted among 267 SMEs in Bulgaria with the main activity of supply of goods and services using the drop-shipping model. Of the total number of surveyed enterprises, 34% introduced ESG factors. The tendency to adopt indicators for assessing the company's sustainability is growing.

articleTitle: Increasing the Supply Chain Competitiveness of Bulgarian Companies by Applying Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the years marked by technological progress, Blockchain technology (BCT) occupies an important place in every sector of the world economy. The trend is also noticeable in developing countries, especially affecting the countries of Central and Eastern Europe. Bulgaria, designated as the fintech capital of the Balkans, is marked by the rising BCT wave, which in turn leads to the growth of the crypto-ecosystem, both at the research level and through the practical use of the technology. As BCT is evolving in two main areas, namely fintech and supply chains, it is appropriate to find out the degree of concentration of individual implementations through which companies want to increase their recognizability globally. For their part, supply chains need to constantly increase their competitiveness, and it is particularly important to examine which tools derived from BCTs can give companies a competitive advantage.

articleTitle: The Role of Digital Content Accessibility in Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: To meet the modern demands of society and to meet certain standards, all governments and organizations must continuously develop and improve both the infrastructure and the services they provide. Since employees, citizens and businesses are key factors in their development, it is essential that all interested parties have access to the information and services provided, and also participate actively in the decision-making processes. The purpose of this publication is to explore the role of accessibility to online content in the managerial decision-making process. The results show that it is important to ensure accessibility to online content at any moment and any stage of the implementation of various processes. In this way, a wider number of employees and users will be involved, regardless of their health problems. The main findings of this study are useful for both decision-makers and those who need to understand and care for the needs of people with disabilities.

articleTitle: Predicting SMEs Performance Level Based on Supply Chain Efficiency and Third-party Logistics Relationships
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The purpose of aforementioned article is providing a commentary on expected performance outcome pathway based on small businesses logistics decisions through verification of business variable indicators and in-depth analysis on working hypotheses on logistics role in the SMEs context. Focus of study is the efficiency of SMEs supply chain management and the quality level of their third-party logistic relationship. The re-search target represents Bulgarian small and medium-sized businesses. The statistics computation demonstrated approval of conducted analysis as reliable in regards of selected variables and conceptual model. The conducted factor analysis confirms the validity of the study. The calculations proved statistical significance of exercised model of linear regression and affirmed that it is applicable for predicting the impact of the factors of analysis on performance having small businesses in Bulgaria based on their decisions in the logistics field.

articleTitle: Modeling the Probability Distribution of Electrical Power Importations Using Kernel Density Estimation Model
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Ensuring the availability of electricity is an economic issue and a major challenge for power system operators. At any time, they have to forecast the demand and ensure the supply by playing on domestic sources of production or on importations. In this paper, the modeling of the electricity importation of the Benin Electric Community (CEB) has been performed using two different Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) models and six parametric models. CEB imports electricity from the Volta River Authority (VRA), Calabar Generation Company Limited via the Transmission Company of Nigeria (TCN) network and the Benin Electric Power Company (SBEE). The objective here is to be able to predict the availability of the sources at a given time. Several performance criteria were used as well as the Kolmogorov Smirnov and Chi-square statistical tests to identify the best fit and acceptable models. The kernel-based estimation models are in the top positions. The KDE_ISJ model models well the importations from TCN and VRA while the KDE_SIL model is better for SBEE.

articleTitle: Models for the digitization of the learning process in higher schools / on the example of University of National and World Economy/
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The report presents models for the digitization of the learning process in higher schools on the example of the University of National and World Economy. The experience and good practices of the university in the field of digitization of university education are presented.

articleTitle: Methodology for Effective Distribution of Manufacture Capacities in a High-Tech Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In order for an investor to make a decision to finance a specific solar system, it is necessary to estimate the payback period of the capital investment, based on the electricity produced. The final product of the solar installation is considered to be a function of the weather and climate, the installation and orientation of the panels, their shading, the slope of the terrain, their maintenance and the initial administrative costs of legalization. It is of great importance how high-quality the elements from which this photovoltaic park is built are, so that it functions most efficiently. The present study describes a methodology for the effective distribution of manufacture capacities in a high-tech enterprise in the manufacture of elements for a Photovoltaic Plant.

articleTitle: Electricity Grids Facing Cyber Threats: What Approaches For Electricity Companies?
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The integration of ICTs within electric energy companies has helped to facilitate communication between different sites of the electricity grids and the optimization of the electricity supply chain as well as a remote control. Despite the advantages these technologies offer within electric energy systems, they have exposed electricity grids so much to vulnerabilities, considerably increasing the risks of cyber threats in recent years. However, IT security for the electricity grids of electric energy companies is becoming important. The cyber-attacks that have affected electric energy companies around the world, the different techniques used by cyber attackers, and the approaches to strengthen the security of the electricity grids from cyber threats were presented.

articleTitle: Energy Planning in Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article examines the state and organization of the national energy planning in Bulgaria. It justifies the need for a scientific methodology and legal regulations for drawing up, certification, implementation, analyzing and renewing of a strategic plan for national energy development.

articleTitle: Characteristics, composition and structure of coatings of WC-TiB2-B4C - Ni-Cr-B-Si-C electrodes formed on titanium alloys by contactless electrospark deposition
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The aim of the work is strengthening of titanium surfaces and increase of their wear resistance by using a cheap and simple method - local contactless electrospark deposition LESD with a cylindrical rotating around its axis electrode. A new type of multicomponent coatings of We-based hard-alloy electrodes with additives of B<inf>4</inf>C and TiB<inf>2</inf> and a bonding multimetallic mass of Ni-Cr-B-Si-Fe-C was created. The influence of process parameters and ratios between individual electrode components on the roughness, thickness, composition, structure and tribological characteristics of the coatings was studied by metallographic, profilometric, XRD, SEM, EDX and tribological methods. Dense and uniform coatings with new relief and newly formed wear resistant phases and crystal-amorphous structures were obtained. It was found that the roughness and thickness of the coatings can be varied by LESD modes in the ranges Ra =1.3÷3µ m and δ=6÷22 µm, respectively. Their microhardness ranges from 9 to 14 GPa and their wear resistance is up to 4 times higher than that of titanium substrates. It was determined the mode parameters and electrode compositions at which maximum wear resistance of the coated surfaces was obtained. The resulting dependencies enable controlling the roughness, thickness, composition and properties of coatings and significantly improving titanium surfaces.

articleTitle: The Study of Social Risks Affecting the Financial Stability of the Oil and Gas Industry and The Ways of Enterprise Management
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Over the past few years, there has been a strong trend towards consolidating non-financial reporting standards in order to create uniform international rules for disclosure of information in the field of sustainable development. The geopolitical crisis, military actions on the territory of Ukraine, social discontent, the crisis of the oil and gas sector, global challenges exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic have made environmental, social and management issues (ESG) even more urgent for politicians, boards of directors, managers and the population. The number of investors in the world who make a choice in favor of companies that comply with these principles is increasing. And this is not accidental, since compliance with ESG standards minimizes environmental, social and corporate risks and, in general, has a positive impact on the activities of the entire organization. The article examines the impact of new socio-economic risks on the policy, investment strategies of Kazakhstan oil and gas enterprises and innovative forms of enterprise reporting. The object of the study is the oil and gas companies of Kazakhstan, and in particular their reporting and functioning system.

articleTitle: Management of Sustainable Development as a Task for Coordinated Optimum
publicationTitle: 2022 V International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article presents the initial principles, concepts and definitions for the formulation of the general task for optimal management of sustainable development. The general target function for satisfaction and inherent material and emotional costs of the subjects carrying out exchanges with each other and having a goal for sustainable development is derived. The common task for sustainable development in optimizing the exchange between two or more entities has been formulated. An aggregated algorithm for coherent optimal management to achieve sustainable development of industrial zones and production systems is presented. Conclusions have been made.
